Five comments

Lady Gethin

Another fine Carolan tune, not a polka but a slow listening tune. Lady Gethin was a patron of Carolan’s and for many of his patrons, Carolan would compose songs or tunes in their honour.

↳ Posted by JACKB on March 2nd, 2007.
